method.scope: Exactly the Bend modules in each hash-verified frozen src/compiler.json manifest.
method.physicalLines: Python UTF-8 text splitlines, per module; no generated assembly or headers.
method.codeLines: Nonempty stripped lines excluding lines whose first nonspace character is #.
method.declarations: Line-start def, law and type followed by whitespace; textual counts, not semantic complexity.
method.hostSupport: Physical lines and UTF-8 bytes reported separately, not included in Bend totals.
method.verification: Verify manifest/modules/host/runtime/images against frozen receipt SHA256; verify optional byte and canonicalPath fields; rehash all inputs after counting.
method.imageScope: Checked-B1 raw, equality-derived API and genuine B2 are distinct. B2 export set grows by one private context API.

limitations: Line/declaration counts are reproducible size proxies, not a semantic concept or complexity score.
The extra validate.bend.orig snapshot backup is not in the manifest and is explicitly excluded.
The release helper snapshot delta incorporates the already-selected Phase63 packaging adapter; it is not a newly invented Phase64 compiler feature.
No speed, conformance, release or fixed-point claim follows from these counts.
